summary_en: Janome Corporation raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 15 yen to 75 yen per share from 60 yen announced in May 2026, representing a 25% increase. The payout ratio increased from 51.1% to 63.6%, with the company targeting a DOE of 3% or higher and a consolidated payout ratio of 40% or above.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Janome Corporation raised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, on October 30, 2026. The year-end dividend per share increased by 15 yen to 75 yen, up from the previous forecast of 60 yen announced in May 2026, representing a 25% increase. Full-year dividend per share rose from 60 yen to 75 yen, while the consolidated payout ratio increased from 51.1% to 63.6%.

The company revised its forecast based on current business performance and enhanced shareholder returns, guided by its dividend policy that emphasizes maintaining solid equity, improving capital efficiency, and delivering stable long-term dividends aligned with medium to long-term profit growth. The policy targets a DOE of 3% or higher and a consolidated payout ratio of at least 40%, while aiming for progressive dividend increases over time.

The company stated its commitment to achieving sustainable profit growth and enhanced shareholder returns simultaneously, thereby improving corporate value and meeting shareholder expectations.
